name: @activepieces/piece-savvycal
description: Scheduling tool that lets invitees overlay their calendar when picking a time.

auth.description: Connect your SavvyCal account using OAuth2.

To get your SavvyCal API token:
1. Log in to your SavvyCal account at https://savvycal.com
2. Go to **Settings > Developers**
3. Under **Personal Tokens**, click **Create a token**
4. Give it a name, then click the **...** menu next to it to view the token
5. Copy the **Private Key** (starts with `pt_secret_`) — not the Public Key

**Note:** Keep this token secret — it gives full access to your SavvyCal account.

custom_fields.description: Additional questions configured on the scheduling link (e.g. Company, Why are we meeting?). Filled in dynamically based on the selected link.

metadata.description: Custom key/value pairs to attach to the event. Useful for tracking the source flow or correlating with external systems.

aiMetadata.description: Books a new SavvyCal meeting on a given scheduling link for an attendee at a specific start/end time. Use to schedule a booking on the attendee's behalf; the chosen time must match an available slot on the link (call Get Available Slots first if unsure). Requires the link id, attendee name/email, and time zone in Olson format. Not idempotent — each call creates a separate booking.

cancel_event.name: cancel_event
cancel_event.description: Cancels a scheduled meeting in SavvyCal.

event_id.description: The unique ID of the event to cancel. You can find this from the output of a trigger or the List Events / Get Event actions.

aiMetadata.description: Cancels a scheduled SavvyCal meeting identified by its event id. Use when a booking needs to be called off; obtain the event id from a trigger, List Events, or Get Event. Cancelling an already-cancelled event has no further effect, but this mutates state and is not a read.

get_event.name: get_event
get_event.description: Retrieves the details of a specific scheduled meeting by its ID.

event_id.description: The unique ID of the event. You can find this in the event URL in SavvyCal, or from the output of a trigger or List Events action.

aiMetadata.description: Fetches the full details of a single SavvyCal event by its event id. Use to look up a known booking (attendee, times, state, link); obtain the id from a trigger, List Events, or the event URL. Read-only and idempotent.
